mapper.select: select sur.id, sur.user_id, sur.role_id, sur.creator, sur.updater, sur.update_time, sur.deleted, sur.role_id, sur.status, sr.name as roleName, sr.code as code from system_role sr left join system_user_role sur on sur.role_id=sr.id where sur.user_id=#{id} and sur.status=0
select sr.code as code from system_user_role sur left join system_role sr on sur.role_id=sr.id where sur.user_id=#{id}
select sur.id, sur.user_id, sur.role_id, sr.name as roleName from system_user_role sur left join system_role sr on sur.role_id=sr.id where sur.user_id=#{id} and sur.deleted=0 and sur.status=0

select su.id as id, su.username as username, su.nickname as nickname, su.mobile as mobile, su.email as email, su.avatar as avatar, su.sex as sex, su.status as status, su.login_ip as loginIp, su.login_date as loginDate, su.creator as creator, su.create_time as createTime, su.updater as updater, su.update_time as updateTime, su.remark as remark from system_users su left join system_user_role sur on sur.user_id=su.id where sur.role_id=#{id} and su.deleted=0
